title: Completion Engineer
desc:
We are looking for a
Completion Lead
with the following details :
Location: UAE or TURKEY with IRAQ missions
Duration : 1 year, renewable
Work Scheme : Residential
CANDIDATE PROFILE / QUALIFICATIONS
Professional experience:
Degree: Engineer or equivalent technical background (Technician accepted based on experience),
15+ years of experience in Oil & Gas Projects with focus on Completion scope, Commissioning or Construction.
Proven track records of several successful assignments on similar office/site positions.
Technical competencies:
Strong Knowledge of OPERCOMTM Methodology and ICAPS© software is mandatory
Behavioral competencies:
Experience working in a client role interfacing with EPSCC contractors.
ACTIVITIES
DURING PREPARATION (ENGINEERING) PHASE:
Ensure ICAPS© database is structured, set-up, and populated in alignment with OPERCOM™ methodology and project breakdown structure in a timely manner, for both CPF-2 and NWP packages, including all interfaces scope.
Coordinate with COMPANY and contractor teams to define system boundaries, completion sequences, and handover criteria.
Validate punch list workflows, preservation routines, and maintenance plans to ensure readiness for execution.
Review and approve as needed other relevant completion procedures developed by the EPSCC CTR.
Support the development and review of completion dossiers and ensure traceability of all documentation.
Ensure appropriate management decision-making tools (derived from the Completion database) are developed for the Owner’s use in support of the monitoring and control of Pre-commissioning and Commissioning progress
Participate in readiness reviews and interface meetings to align completion activities with commissioning and operations.
DURING EXECUTION PHASE:
Supervise the COMPANY Completions support team (ICAPS Administrator, Punch List Coordinator, Pre-com/Comm Coordinator).
Ensure with EPCC Contractor an adequate and timely transfer of Quality/Construction punch items from their management system into the Completion Database.
Monitor progress of system completions for both CPF-2 and NWP packages by extracting and using ICAPS data.
Liaise with Construction, Commissioning, and Operations (when applicable) to establish punch list requirements and resolve conflict. Monitors and controls the punch items entered in the Completion database, ensuring priority compliance up to RFC/AoC completion.
Inform the Project Teams (both packages) to support the management of Construction priorities.
Coordinate with commissioning teams to validate RFC, AoC, and TOM (Transfer to Operation and Maintenance) milestones
Monitor the completion of Pre-commissioning and Commissioning dossiers, ensuring all necessary documentation is included.
Ensure accurate and timely reporting of completion status, KPIs, and system handovers.
Facilitate lessons learned capture and contribute to continuous improvement of completion processes.
